'''Cody Ky''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Melbourne tournament (18 February)]] on 18 February 2001 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]], according to Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1780">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-melbourne-australia-18-02-01d1780/ melbourne-australia-18-02-01], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 25 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-melbourne-australia-18-02-01d1780/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
